caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
action: bending something so that it deforms
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The wood must be sufficiently pliable to bend without breaking.
The two individuals must apply opposing forces to bend the wood into a bow shape.
The wood must remain visibly bent in the bow shape throughout the process.
The bending action must be continuous to demonstrate flexibility.
